in_sanskrit.name: दासराथी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who serves Ratha (Chariot), either as a driver or a soldier.

in_hindi.name: दासराथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is a servant and rides a chariot.

in_telugu.name: దాశరాథి

in_marathi.name: Dasarathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ten charioteers, ruler of ten
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dasarathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dasara’ meaning ten and ‘rathi’ meaning charioteer or ruler. The name ‘Dasarathi’ signifies one who rules over ten charioteers, a powerful king.
